text:
Ivy: quick follow-up from the scheduler design huddle \u2014 wanted to capture the new invariants we discussed for continuous batching
Theo: great, this is the thread to iterate on the state invariants and admission accounting
Rina: main problem: tentative reservations help coalesce but break fairness and cause KV churn
Sam: can we define a strict invariant: "admission_credit_count only reflects confirmed slots; tentative_slots are accounted separately as 'soft tokens'"?
Ivy: yes. separate ledger: hard_credits (int) and soft_credits (fractional). Hard credits drive eviction/fair-share, soft credits influence local gating only
Theo: invariant 2: at most N_soft concurrent soft tokens per tenant per shard, enforced at enqueue time
Rina: invariant 3: soft token lifetime <= T_soft_ms and eviction of soft-related resources must be idempotent
Sam: also need invariant about transition monotonicity: Tentative -> Confirmed is allowed, but Confirmed -> Tentative is forbidden
Ivy: important for reasoning about fairness counters and to avoid double-counting during race windows
Theo: implementation sketch (pseudo):
```
on_request(req):
  if tenant.soft_count < N_soft && heuristic(req):
    issue_soft_token(req.id)
    soft_count++
  else
    attempt_hard_admit(req)

on_soft_timeout(token):
  if batch.occupancy >= K:
    promote_to_hard(token)
  else:
    release_soft(token)
```
Rina: fairness ledger change: when promote_to_hard, transfer fractional soft value into hard accounting using conversion factor alpha<1; repeated soft-only attempts decay accounted weight
Sam: we also discussed eviction_backoff: if tenant suffers M evictions within window W, reduce N_soft for that tenant by factor, with exponential backoff reset on quiet period
Ivy: yes, and add escape for SLO-critical routes: route-level override to bypass reduced N_soft but increment a high-priority usage counter for billing/alerts
Theo: telemetry needs: per-tenant hard_credits, soft_tokens, soft_promote_rate, eviction_count_windowed, eviction_backoff_factor, route_override_uses
Rina: rollout: feature-flag soft_token_mode=false initially. Canary on 3 shards with conservative N_soft=2, T_soft=20ms, K=3 for 72h
Sam: success criteria: no >5% increase in per-tenant memory footprint, soft_promote_rate>0.5 and p95 latency improves by >=30ms on median of target tenants
Ivy: rollback triggers: per-shard eviction_count > baseline*1.4 for 10m OR mem_increase>10% sustained 15m
Theo: long-term refactor note: move admission heuristic out of scheduler into a pluggable predictor service so we can replace heuristic(req) with model.predict_coalesce(req) without touching batch state machine
Rina: agreed. also add an operator visible knob to convert soft attempts into billing metrics so product can decide monetization later
infra-bot: scheduled: canary deploy to shard-g now with feature soft_token_mode=false; monitor alarms will be created automatically
Ivy: I'll draft the follow-up RFC with the invariants, pseudo-code, fairness math (alpha schedule), and a short ops playbook. ping me for reviews :meat_on_bone:
